summary: New project: single-module Spring Boot 3.5.6 (Maven, Java) URL shortener with an in-memory ConcurrentHashMap store (putIfAbsent for atomic code/alias uniqueness, AtomicLong click counter), JSON API under /api, root-level GET /{code} 302 redirect, centralized error mapping (422/400/404/409), JUnit 5 + MockMvc tests. | stack: Java (compiled with java.release=17, runs on the locally installed JDK 25)/Spring Boot 3.5.6 (spring-boot-starter-web, spring-boot-starter-validation, spring-boot-starter-test) | test: mvn -B -q test

stack.language: Java (compiled with java.release=17, runs on the locally installed JDK 25)
stack.rationale: Stack is mandated by the requirement (Java, Spring Boot, Maven, JUnit). Boot 3.5.6 parent is already in the local ~/.m2 so build works offline; release 17 is the Boot 3 baseline and compiles on JDK 25. Only three starters to keep supply-chain surface minimal.

components: pom.xml: spring-boot-starter-parent 3.5.6, java.version 17, starters web/validation/test only
LinkController: POST /api/links, GET /api/links/{code}, GET /{code} redirect (302, Cache-Control: no-store)

LinkService: validates URL (java.net.URI, http/https case-insensitive, non-empty host, <=2048, no whitespace/control chars/CRLF, no userinfo) and alias (full-match ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{3,32}$, case sensitive, reserved names rejected); generates 7-char SecureRandom [A-Za-z0-9] codes with bounded retry (10)
LinkStore: only storage class; ConcurrentHashMap<String, Link> with putIfAbsent; Link record holds code, url and AtomicLong clicks
CodeGenerator: small injectable interface/functional bean so tests can force collisions
ApiExceptionHandler: @RestControllerAdvice mapping validation to 422, unreadable JSON to 400, unknown code to 404, taken alias to 409, no stack traces in body
SecurityHeadersFilter or controller-set headers: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy: no-referrer
application.properties: app.base-url=http://localhost:8080, request size caps, no INFO-level logging of URLs
src/test/java: LinkApiTest (MockMvc, S1-S7, R1/R2/R6/R9/R10/R11), ConcurrencyTest (R3/R5), LinkServiceTest (R4 collision with injected generator), LinkStoreTest (R8)
README.md: run/test commands, API examples, ephemeral-storage and open-redirect warnings
api: POST /api/links  body {"url": string, "alias": string optional}  -> 201 {"code", "shortUrl", "url"}; 422 invalid/missing url or invalid/reserved alias; 409 alias taken; 400 unparseable JSON
GET /{code}  -> 302 Found with single Location header = stored URL, Cache-Control: no-store; increments click count by one; 404 unknown code
GET /api/links/{code}  -> 200 {"code", "url", "clicks"}; 404 unknown code; does not change the click count
Error body (all errors): {"error": string, "message": string} with no exception class names or stack traces
shortUrl = app.base-url + "/" + code (never derived from Host / X-Forwarded-Host)

adr.decision: In-memory ConcurrentHashMap store behind one LinkStore class; no database.
adr.rationale: Minimal for the requirement and orchestrator guidance. putIfAbsent gives atomic uniqueness for both aliases and generated codes. Persistence ceiling: all links and clicks are lost on restart and memory is unbounded; a database implementation can replace LinkStore later with its own migration plan.

adr.decision: Redirect with 302 Found and Cache-Control: no-store; redirect route is root-level GET /{code}, API under /api.
adr.rationale: Human decision A4. 302 plus no-store keeps clicks counted. Separate /api prefix plus reserved-name rejection means a code can never shadow an API route.

adr.decision: Clicks are AtomicLong in the Link record, incremented only on successful redirect lookup.
adr.rationale: Avoids lost updates under concurrent redirects without locks; stats reads never count.

adr.decision: Hand-written URL validation with java.net.URI in LinkService; Bean Validation only for presence/shape of fields, mapped to 422.
adr.rationale: No extra libraries; scheme/host/length/control-char rules from clarify A1 are not expressible with @URL alone. Single validation point at create; redirect trusts only stored validated values.

adr.decision: Pin Spring Boot parent 3.5.6 and java.version 17.
adr.rationale: 3.5.6 is available in the local Maven cache (offline reproducible); JDK 25 is installed locally and compiles release 17 bytecode.

decisions.value: Only http/https (case-insensitive), non-empty host, max 2048 chars, no whitespace/control chars/CRLF, no userinfo; otherwise 422
Regex ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{3,32}$ full match, case sensitive, reserved names (api, links, actuator, error, h2-console) rejected with 422; taken alias 409
Each successful redirect increments by one; unknown codes and stats reads do not; count exposed at GET /api/links/{code}
302 Found with Location header and Cache-Control: no-store
422 for missing/invalid fields, 400 for unparseable JSON
7 chars, SecureRandom over [A-Za-z0-9], shared keyspace with aliases, up to 10 putIfAbsent attempts then 503 without overwriting
Spring Boot 3.5.6, java.version 17, built on local JDK 25
mvn -B -q test (no install step; deps must already be resolved by setup)

assumptions: Maven (mvn) and JDK are on PATH, and Boot 3.5.6 artifacts are in ~/.m2 or Maven Central is reachable during setup.
Service listens on default port 8080 and sits behind no proxy; app.base-url is set per deployment.
Exhausted code-generation retries return 503 (practically unreachable with 62^7 keyspace).
The service is not exposed publicly as-is; rate limiting and blocklists are follow-up before public exposure.
tradeoffs: In-memory store: simplest and race-free via ConcurrentHashMap, but not durable and not shared across instances.
Hand-rolled validation over a validation library: fewer dependencies, slightly more code to test.
302 over 301: every click hits the service (accurate counts) at the cost of no browser/CDN caching.
Root-level /{code} gives short URLs, requiring reserved-name rejection for aliases.
limitations: All links and click counts are lost on restart (ephemeral, documented in README).
No cap on number of links and no rate limiting: memory exhaustion/abuse possible if exposed publicly.
Open redirect / phishing abuse is inherent to a public shortener; only scheme/host validation is done, no SSRF target or blocklist filtering of private hosts.
Stored URLs are plain text and readable by anyone who knows the code via the stats endpoint.
Single instance only; no authentication, no link deletion or expiry.
rollback_plan: New project with no prior release: rollback is to stop the service and revert/discard the release commit or tag (git revert of the release commit, or redeploy the previous artifact if any). There is no database, schema or migration, and in-memory data is ephemeral, so no data restore is needed; deleting the target/ directory removes build output. If persistence is added later, that release must carry its own forward/backward migration plan.

risk_coverage.validation: Parameterized MockMvc test in LinkApiTest: javascript:, data:, file:, ftp:, 'http://', 'http://a b', userinfo URL, 2049-char, null/blank url return 422; HTTP://ok.com and valid URLs return 201.

MockMvc: redirect is 302 with single Location equal to stored URL and nosniff/Referrer-Policy headers; URLs with raw CR/LF or %0d%0a rejected 422; security stage checklist; README documents open-redirect caveat.
ConcurrencyTest: 50 threads with CountDownLatch create same alias; assert exactly one 201, 49 409, stored URL is the winner's.
LinkServiceTest with injected CodeGenerator returning a duplicate first then a unique code: existing link untouched, new link gets second code; exhausted retries error without overwrite.
ConcurrencyTest: 100 threads x 10 redirects then GET /api/links/{code} returns exactly 1000; unknown code 404; stats reads leave count unchanged.
Parameterized MockMvc: 'ab', 33 chars, 'a b', 'a/b', 'a.b', unicode, 'abc\n', 'api' give 422; 'abc', 'A_b-9', 32 chars give 201; 'Abc' and 'abc' coexist.
MockMvc/size-cap test: ~1 MB body rejected with 4xx and nothing stored; URL cap 2048 tested under R1; unbounded map documented as known ceiling in README and limitations.
LinkStoreTest exercises only public methods; README review confirms ephemeral-storage warning.
MockMvc: missing url 422, malformed JSON 400, unknown code 404 on redirect and stats, duplicate alias 409; body asserted free of exception class names/stack traces.
MockMvc: redirect status 302, Location equals original URL, Cache-Control: no-store present.
MockMvc: create with spoofed Host: evil.example header; shortUrl starts with configured app.base-url.

Release stage runs documented setup/test/run commands verbatim from a clean checkout plus curl smoke; traceability check that S1-S7 each have an asserting test; mutation spot check of the 409 and 404 branches; pinned Boot 3.5.6.
Review pom.xml has only web, validation, test starters; run mvn dependency:tree to confirm no unexpected artifacts.
Create and redirect a URL containing a fake token, capture log output and assert the token is absent (no URL/body logging at INFO); README privacy note reviewed.
